subject: Subprocessor onboarding notice and KMS handoff — control matrix & eSign
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@acmecloud.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, michael_grant@redwood.com
Date: 2025-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Subprocessor onboarding notice and KMS handoff — control matrix & eSign

Hi Olivia —

Quick note to follow up on our procurement call last week. Per the DPA schedule, Redwood will be onboarding a new subprocessor (LogicaOps) to support telemetry/observability for the Dedicated offering. As part of the onboarding we need to:

- Provide ACME with our TOMs exhibit updates (encryption at rest, access control matrix, key custody flow).
- Confirm the KMS handoff approach for any BYOK scenarios (we currently support a tenant-managed key flow and an optional key-escrow model).
- Share the subprocessor notice and control matrix template so ACME can validate.

Attached: acme_control_matrix_template.xlsx — a short template you can fill. Also attaching a draft redline of the TOMs exhibit (redline_toms_exhibit_v2.pdf).

Would you prefer we route the DPA amendment via DocuSign or AdobeSign? If DocuSign, I can prepare an envelope with the TOMs exhibit and subprocessor notice and send it over for an e-sign.

Target timeline from our side: provide final exhibit edits by 6/23 so legal has a few business days to review prior to signatures. If that timeline is tight for ACME, let me know and we can adjust.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: acme_control_matrix_template.xlsx (Excel, 42KB)
Attachment: redline_toms_exhibit_v2.pdf (PDF, 135KB)

From: Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@acmecloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: ACME Cloud Legal <legal@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2025-06-18T13:45:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Subprocessor onboarding notice and KMS handoff — control matrix & eSign

Ben —

Thanks for the heads up and the docs. A few quick clarifications from our security team:

1) For BYOK flows we need confirmation that Redwood does NOT retain plaintext keys during any part of the onboarding and that the KMS handoff uses a direct customer-to-HSM import or a documented escrow path guarded by dual-control.
2) Access control matrix: we will add a column for "separation of duties" and need clarification on which Redwood roles map to admin vs. operator.
3) Subprocessor notice: we need an SLA excerpt showing incident notification timings for LogicaOps specifically (their proposed SLA isn't in the original notice).

Attached I uploaded a filled copy of your control matrix (see updated sheet "ACME review"). I can sign either way (DocuSign preferred) but legal would like the TOMs exhibit to explicitly call out key rotation cadence and escrow retrieval procedure.

Can you iterate on the redline and re-send? If you prepare the envelope, please include a single PDF with the DPA amendment + TOMs exhibit + subprocessor notice in that order.

—Olivia
Olivia Harper
Head of Cloud Security, ACME Cloud
olivia.harper@acmecloud.com

Attachment: acme_control_matrix_filled.xlsx (Excel, 48KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@acmecloud.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, michael_grant@redwood.com
Date: 2025-06-19T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Subprocessor onboarding notice and KMS handoff — control matrix & eSign

Olivia —

Appreciate the quick review and the updates to the matrix. We incorporated your separation-of-duties column and added a new subsection in the TOMs exhibit to explicitly describe:

• Key custody: Redwood supports three patterns — tenant-managed (customer imports key into their KMS/HSM and Redwood only sees wrapped key material), Redwood-managed with HSM-backed wrapping (keys generated in customer tenant HSM), and Redwood-managed with escrow (dual-control retrieval by customer only).

• No plaintext keys are ever sent to Redwood or persisted by Redwood. The steps for import and escrow are in section 4.2 of the attached redline.

• Rotation cadence: default 365 days; can be set to 90/180/365 per customer request; rotation procedure added to Exhibit B.

I attached an updated redline (redline_toms_exhibit_v3.pdf). If that looks good to ACME Legal, I'll prepare a DocuSign envelope. Proposed reviewers from our side: Laura Bennett (Security PM) and Michael Grant (Infrastructure Ops) — copying them for internal review.

Proposed DocuSign envelope: DPA Amendment (one-sheeter), Exhibit B (TOMs redline v3), Subprocessor notice (LogicaOps statements). I'll upload to Drive and send the DocuSign link once internal review is green.

Thanks,
Ben

Attachment: redline_toms_exhibit_v3.pdf (PDF, 168KB)
Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-control-matrix

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-20T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Subprocessor onboarding notice and KMS handoff — control matrix & eSign

Ben —

Quick internal notes before we send to ACME:
- I reviewed redline_toms_exhibit_v3.pdf. Section 4.2 wording on "wrapped key handling" looks good but add a line about audit logging retention (we keep KMS import events for 7 years). Can you add that to Exhibit B?
- Michael, confirm that LogicaOps will be placed in a restricted tenancy with per-service IAM roles; we should document the separation-of-duties mapping to our IR/ops runbooks.

If both items are fine, Ben please proceed to prepare DocuSign. For the envelope sign order: ACME (Olivia/legal) -> Redwood security lead (Laura) -> Redwood contracts (Ben) -> Redwood infra (Michael) — this ensures legal/ops countersign sequence is preserved.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Security PM, Redwood Inference

Ben / team —

Thanks for the iteration. ACME Legal has reviewed the redline and confirms the updated Exhibit B addresses the BYOK and rotation concerns. Two small asks before we close:

1) Please confirm in writing the incident notification SLA for LogicaOps: Redwood commits to 72-hour initial notification for non-critical events and immediate notification (within 1 hour) for incidents impacting encryption keys or key material.
2) We will countersign in DocuSign; please include the final executed envelope link and the envelope ID for our records.

Envelope (signed): https://docusign.example.com/envelope/DOCU-ACME-2025-6789
